correctness.rationale: Independent exponential-clock blade races establish the exact product; competing rates scale with the number of free clique vertices. Independence follows from separate blade-specific clock families until first hub deposition. Parity follows from maximality of adsorption. Gamma quotient and uniform Taylor bounds prove both asymptotic regimes for all quantified parameters. Independent exact-rational full-state recursion passed 36 comparisons plus 30 parity/one-pair checks; finite tests support, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: The probability a highly connected hub survives irreversible adsorption is a natural rare jammed-state observable in a clustered graph. The exact all-size weighted law contrasts algebraic hub protection with different topology-induced decay, and the two-parameter rate/number-of-blades crossover at rb log k of order one gives a motivated sharp size-rate boundary. It is not an arbitrary finite slice, name change, or pretabulated computation.
